scripts.copy:fontawesome: shx cp node_modules/font-awesome/css/font-awesome.min.css css && shx cp node_modules/font-awesome/fonts/* fonts
scripts.copy:select2: shx cp node_modules/select2/dist/js/select2.min.js js/vendor && shx cp node_modules/select2/dist/css/select2.min.css css
scripts.copy:bootstrap: shx cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.min.js js/vendor && shx cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css css
scripts.copy:vendor: npm run copy:bootstrap && npm run copy:jquery && npm run copy:fontawesome && npm run copy:select2
